task_description: Final improvements to the Matanglawin Crack Detection System: improve ML detection (preprocessing, validation, false positive reduction), fix alert sound, add blinking warning banner, replace LetsView capture backend, add system stability/resilience, remove unnecessary UI stats, apply dark theme, simplify detection history, and polish the interface for research defense presentation.

verification.summary: All integration tests pass (40+ assertions). Tests cover: module imports, Flask endpoints (including new DELETE/PATCH), database CRUD with notes migration, PDF generation, crack validator with DJI UI zone rejection, image quality validation, preprocessing (CLAHE/gamma), confidence defaults, and temporal verification with time-spread. Tests are meaningful - they exercise real code paths and would fail if changes were reverted.
